dx_rating.justification: The TypeScript implementation shows strong type safety and modern patterns. However, there are opportunities for improvement in error handling and configuration management.

concerns.title: Inconsistent Error Handling
concerns.description: Error handling patterns vary across the codebase, making it difficult to maintain and debug. Some functions throw exceptions while others return error objects.
concerns.recommended_fix: Standardize on a consistent error handling approach, preferably using Result types or a centralized error handler.

concerns.title: Missing Type Guards
concerns.description: Several functions accept union types but lack proper type guards, leading to potential runtime errors.

files: src/models/user.ts:89 - No validation for UserRole enum

concerns.recommended_fix: Add type guard functions for all union types and use them consistently.

recommendations.title: Implement Result Type Pattern
recommendations.description: Adopt a Result<T, E> type pattern for all operations that can fail, replacing try-catch blocks and error callbacks.
recommendations.implementation:
1. Create a Result type in src/types/result.ts
2. Update all async functions to return Result types
3. Add helper functions (isOk, isErr, unwrap)
4. Update error handling documentation
benefits: Explicit error handling in type signatures
Better IDE autocomplete for error cases
risks: Large refactor across codebase (mitigate: do incrementally)
Learning curve for team (mitigate: provide examples and training)

recommendations.title: Add Comprehensive Type Guards
recommendations.description: Create type guard functions for all union types and discriminated unions.
recommendations.implementation:
1. Create type-guards.ts with guard functions
2. Use guards before unsafe operations
3. Add tests for each guard function

strengths.title: Strong Type Coverage
strengths.description: The codebase maintains excellent type coverage with minimal use of 'any'. TypeScript strict mode is enabled throughout.

strengths.title: Modern ES Features
strengths.description: Good use of modern JavaScript features like async/await, destructuring, and optional chaining.
